title: Rotating material axes invalidate a frozen-axis coating comparison
statement: The convected-axis ionic model adds a distributed source. For rho>=1 its positive Green-kernel comparison preserves the responsive sufficient stability bound, but the former ordinary-coating instability witness no longer establishes a physical advantage. Both corrected designs are stable at the original 1MPa fixture.

requires: specified anisotropic ionic skin with material axes rotating under deformation
assumptions: 10kPa separation is one model region, not an acquired material
earlier frozen-model reviews do not automatically certify the later extension
contract.units: q in inverse meters, stiffness/load in source SI conventions
contract.obstruction: Prevents recycling a wrong constitutive branch as proof of materials superiority.
